def min_missed_meals(b, d, s):
    # Find the maximum of the three values
    max_meals = max(b, d, s)
    
    # Calculate the minimum number of missed meals
    missed_meals = 0
    for i in range(3):
        if max_meals - 1 > [b, d, s][i]:
            missed_meals += max_meals - 1 - [b, d, s][i]
    
    return missed_meals
